system.description:
Poor quality bow (+1 Ob to hit) 3 rps; poor quality crossbow (+1 Ob to hit) 4 rps; run of the mill bow 5 rps; run of the mill crossbow 6 rps; iron-cased bombs 10 rps. Includes enough missiles; special heads 1 rp apiece. Use the ranged weapon items.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 242
